commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+2' Manu Sanchez comes off the pitch to be replaced by Asier Villalibre (Alaves).
90+1' 0 - 1 Goal! Jhon Elmer Solis Romero (Girona) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 0:1.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
88' Jhon Elmer Solis Romero (Girona) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
88' A player from Alaves commits a rough challenge. Mateo Busquets blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Girona are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
85' The linesman signals that Carlos Vicente (Alaves) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
84' Alaves can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
84' Paulo Gazzaniga blocks a long-range effort from Tomas Conechny (Alaves) towards the roof of the net. Alaves force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
83' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
81' Mateo Busquets shows a yellow card to Cristhian Stuani (Girona) for his blatant foul.
79' Alaves failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
78' Neat passing move from Alaves in order to create new attacking opportunities.
77' That's the end of the game for Bryan Gil, who is replaced by Jhon Elmer Solis Romero (Girona).
75' Toni Martinez (Alaves) has the goal in his sights after a good run to the edge of the box, but his weak effort flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Girona will have a goal kick.
74' Bryan Gil (Girona) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
73' The resulting set piece from Alaves is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
72' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Kike Garcia walks off the pitch to be replaced by Toni Martinez (Alaves).
70' Michel has decided to substitute Abel Ruiz and he is replaced by Cristhian Stuani (Girona).
70' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) will replace Donny van de Beek.
68' Girona seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
67' A lofted cross from Tomas Conechny (Alaves) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
64' Golden chance! Tomas Conechny (Alaves) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the left post.
63' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Girona comes to nothing.
63' Daley Blind (Girona) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
60' Moussa Diarra (Alaves) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
59' Bryan Gil (Girona) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
55' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jon Guridi (Alaves) was quite harsh and Mateo Busquets didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
54' Jon Guridi (Alaves) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
53' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
53' Referee Mateo Busquets sees the trip by Antonio Blanco (Alaves) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Free kick. Girona will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
52' The resulting corner, taken by Carlos Vicente (Alaves), comes to nothing.
52' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball goes out of play. Alaves are awarded a corner kick.
49' Ladislav Krejci (Girona) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
49' The attendance for today's match is 16454.
49' Daley Blind (Girona) trips an opposition player and Mateo Busquets signals a foul.
46' Michel has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Oriol Romeu (Girona) comes on the pitch for Ivan Martin.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' Mateo Busquets blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' Yangel Herrera (Girona) has tested the patience of referee Mateo Busquets and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

45' Ander Guevara (Alaves) blew a promising chance when he got to a rebound just outside the penalty area. He struck it low towards the middle of the target, but Paulo Gazzaniga pulled off a nice save and to stop the attempt.
44' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

44' Alaves play a few nice passes from player to player, but their possession doesn't last long as an opposition player intercepts a pass. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Alaves.
44' The Alaves players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
40' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty as the referee indicates there was no infringement.
39' There's a break in play and referee Mateo Busquets must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Alaves using VAR. This could be interesting!
39' One of the Alaves players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
37' The corner from Carlos Vicente (Alaves) is hurriedly cleared.
35' Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Mateo Busquets had an easy-decision to make.
33' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) limps off the pitch to be replaced by Arnaut Danjuma.
32' Alaves are passing the ball across the pitch and keep possession. However, an opponent intercepts a pass and the situation changes.
30' Problems for Eduardo Coudet as Joan Jordan (Alaves) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Ander Guevara replaces him.
30' Eduardo Coudet is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Carlos Martin (Alaves) suffers an injury and Tomas Conechny comes on.
29' The game is interrupted now, Carlos Martin (Alaves) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
28' Kike Garcia (Alaves) lacks options so fires a shot at goal from the edge of box, but it's a wasted effort and goes high over the bar.
26' Girona control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
25' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
24' Mateo Busquets blows his whistle. Jon Guridi (Alaves) commits a foul after dangerous play. There is a free kick near the sideline to Girona.

23' What a great effort! Ladislav Krejci (Girona) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches over the crossbar. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
21' Manu Sanchez (Alaves) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
16' Bryan Gil (Girona) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
15' Abdel Abqar (Alaves) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Mateo Busquets blows his whistle for a foul.
14' Bryan Gil (Girona) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
13' Bryan Gil (Girona) swings in a cross from the corner, but Jesus Owono reads it well and gathers the ball. The referee signals a corner kick to Girona.
13' Bryan Gil (Girona) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
10' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Girona, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
10' Manu Sanchez (Alaves) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play. Girona are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
8' Arnau Martinez (Girona) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.

7' Girona players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass. The ball is out of play. Alaves will take a throw-in.
6' Ivan Martin (Girona) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Mateo Busquets blows for a foul.
5' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Girona.
4' Great teamplay by Alaves as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

Girona will kick the game off.
